data.narrative:
Deep Sentinel, a Series B-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $55M to date, is evaluated against a comparable universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms spanning the sector. The peer set includes Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $55M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $104M. Peer-median analysis across the 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The material dispersion reflects heterogeneity in technology maturity, customer concentration, and capital efficiency within the Defense & Security frontier-tech cohort.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $89M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $552M. The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty around Deep Sentinel's positioning relative to more mature, higher-capitalized peers in the peer set. Key drivers of placement within this range include revenue run-rate, customer acquisition velocity, gross margin profile, and regulatory pathway clarity—none of which are quantified in available data. The stage-progression method alone appears conservative relative to peer medians, warranting weight toward the upper half of the triangulated range pending disclosure of operational metrics.
